name: Fenghua District

routes.outcome: Official Ningbo 甬地网 viewer loaded. Current HTML exposed JavaScript configuration with API base https://land.zgj.ningbo.gov.cn/qyzd/api and a map/promotion front end, but not a cadastral registry layer.

Viewer JavaScript was inspected. It exposed /land/marketPageList and /cloudMap/landCountList calls whose returned mapValue/data payloads are for land-promotion listings and are encrypted/serialized by the client; no cadastral schema or CRS was exposed.
Anonymous request returned status 10001 with two encrypted data/list entries. It is a land-market listing response, not a verified cadastral parcel response; no fields or geometry were retained.

Anonymous request returned status 10001 with encrypted data entries. No safe parcel ID, geometry, source CRS, or cadastral field mapping was recoverable without using private credentials or unsafe decryption assumptions.

Official Ningbo real-estate registration appointment page explicitly lists 奉化 among the six covered districts and identifies Ningbo real-estate registration custody/service. The page requires real-name appointment fields and was not used for login or personal-data access.

Official PDF contains a Fenghua Economic Development Zone parcel-plan example with native-looking parcel number 330283004357GB00047 and a diagram, but it is a document example rather than a machine-readable citywide parcel service. No polygon was extracted or retained.

schemaAndCrs.viewerConfig: https://land.zgj.ningbo.gov.cn/ exposes VITE_BASE_API=https://land.zgj.ningbo.gov.cn/qyzd/api and a map URL, but the inspected routes are land-promotion routes.
schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: No cadastral geometry response obtained; CRS and coordinate order remain unverified.
schemaAndCrs.sourceFieldMapping: Land-market client fields include id/mapValue/landName/regionName/landArea, but these were not treated as cadastral fields or retained.
schemaAndCrs.boundedAnonymousResponse: Two bounded anonymous POST attempts returned encrypted/serialized land-market data; no safe cadastral identity-plus-geometry response.

localCustodianAssessment: Ningbo's official registration service page evidences local municipal registration custody covering Fenghua, and the official PDF evidences a Fenghua parcel-plan document. The 甬地网 public viewer is a general land-promotion service, not evidence of a public cadastral vector endpoint. General national material was not treated as local registry evidence.

qualification.reason: No anonymous cadastral parcel geometry or city-bounded public vector response was verified; serial review must independently qualify any real adapter before runtime consideration.

scopeLimits: The exact WUP point and latitude/longitude order were preserved; no coordinate was shifted to force a parcel hit.
No exact-point parcel hit or miss was used as a citywide absence claim.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, certificate, or personal fields were requested or retained.
No GeoJSON sample is retained because no safe full parcel polygon and native identity were obtained.
The public viewer's successful responses were land-market/promotional and encrypted/serialized; they were not presented as cadastral evidence.
This packet records research completion only and is not source integration or registry admission.
uncertainty: Local registration custody is supported, but anonymous cadastral service reachability, parcel schema/CRS, coverage, update cadence, licensing, and runtime behavior remain unverified. The absence of a public vector endpoint is an access/discovery limitation, not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
